name: Nihongo Master v1.1.2
changelog: v1.1.2: Refactored title menu and stage select flow so Stage Select only comes up once a game is selected. Title menu cleanly lists the 3 arcade games (Hiragana Arcade, Katakana Arcade, 3D Hiragana Cards) plus Options, Check for Updates, and Quit. Selecting any game opens a dedicated mission briefing and stage select screen with live syllabary preview and stage details before starting.
